requested_outcome: Add genuinely recommended, source-backed, detailed trails for underrepresented Sharon and Lowlands areas.
natural_destination: Public trail collections, cards and detail pages in the VII trails world.
authorization_boundary: Implement and verify locally without publishing or deploying this candidate.

lesson_bundle.reason: Trail facts and closures can change and must not be invented.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every route uses an official authority page and excludes known closed candidates.

lesson_bundle.reason: Public destination imagery needs verified identity and reuse terms.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every new route has an exact-location image, creator, source and license.

lesson_bundle.reason: Trail discovery and detail pages are frequently used on phones.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The changed family must be checked at a mobile viewport as well as desktop.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The new entries are generic filler rather than routes worth recommending.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Select only established routes from official authority guides and write a concrete itinerary.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Each route has at least four highlights and three route-plan steps.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A route is closed or its distance and safety facts are invented.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Exclude the known closed candidates and retain a direct official source for every route.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every official source resolves on the Parks Authority or KKL domain.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Cards show missing or unrelated imagery without rights information.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use exact-location Commons media with explicit creator, source and license metadata.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every added route has image, credit, source and license fields and the URL responds.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The Sharon and Lowlands collections exist but do not filter their inventory.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Apply both the Center region and the relevant textual subregion query in the topic contract.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The two topic definitions and server-side topic count use the same query rule.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The activity hub count becomes stale after adding routes.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Derive the visible number directly from the trail inventory.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No hardcoded 48-trail public count remains in the activities page.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Desktop works while mobile imagery or attribution overflows.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep attribution inside the image boundary and run responsive visual checks.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A Sharon and Lowlands detail page have no horizontal overflow at desktop and 390 pixels.

sources.label: Official route authorities
sources.source: Israel Nature and Parks Authority and KKL route guides

midpoint_gate.trigger: After data and topic implementation but before visual approval.
checks: Validate all eight source and image contracts.
Run trail-family and topic regression tests.
Confirm Sharon and Lowlands each expose at least four matching routes.

attack_questions: Can an unrelated route enter either regional collection?
Can any new card render a missing image?
Can a route claim accessibility or safety not stated in its source?
Can a mobile detail page overflow because of the attribution badge?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Open the two regional collections and representative detail pages in the rendered application.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Run the existing trail, topic, sitemap, translation and responsive family tests.

effectiveness.baseline: The Center area had only six routes and weak Sharon and Lowlands subregional depth.
effectiveness.target: Eight source-backed routes deepen both subregions and remain discoverable through dedicated collections.
